_comment: Committed evidence for the two VAST-sweep detections of ASKAP J183950.5-075635 (SBIDs 62032, 62646) and the published-epoch recoveries in the same sweep. Same shape as lptv_detection_provenance.json. All quoted numbers transcribed 2026-08-15 from the papers' arXiv e-print sources.

lee_observation_table.gap_note: No ASKAP observation between 2024-03-15 (SBID 60091) and 2024-06-26 (SBID 63296). SBIDs 62032 (2024-05-03) and 62646 (2024-06-07) fall in that gap and appear nowhere in the table.

lee_ephemeris_and_pulse_properties.t0_provenance: de-dispersed sub-pulse at 2024-02-18 05:53:09 UTC, described as 'near the centre of the full pulse'; anchor systematic ~ +/-0.013 in phase for a ~10-min pulse
lee_ephemeris_and_pulse_properties.interpulse_phase_provenance: 'roughly 3.2 hours after the main pulse' / 3.2 h / 6.45 h; arrival times of the weaker pulses 'fluctuate'
lee_ephemeris_and_pulse_properties.interpulse_circular_fraction: <~10% (source-parameter table); prose: '90% linearly polarised with negligible circular polarisation'
lee_ephemeris_and_pulse_properties.timing_jitter: EQUAD_MP = 50 s, EQUAD_IP = 100 s (Methods); main-pulse durations 320-710 s

detection_sbid_62032.trials_note: 6.43 sigma local; two-sided p = 1.28e-10 x 647 measured epochs = 8.3e-8 = 5.4 sigma global

interpulse_consistency.flux_ratio: 12.161/68.223 = 17.8% of the SBID-62646 pulse, inside the published 10-20% interpulse band (both are 12-min averages of different epochs, not a clean per-pulse ratio)
interpulse_consistency.polarization_tension: 18 +/- 3% circular vs the published interpulse <~10% (and below the main-pulse 30-60%): ~2.8 sigma above the interpulse band. The identification is therefore reported as a CANDIDATE interpulse.

detection_sbid_62032.artifact_exclusion: V/I = 18% is 29x the 0.6% leakage floor; the same position gives |V| < 1 sigma in 43 other measured VAST epochs (not a standing instrumental term); no I-catalogue source > 4 mJy within 2 arcmin and no blind-V source within 60 arcsec (lptv_j183950_adjudication.json)

detection_sbid_62646.toa_offset: 0.0488 in phase = 18.9 min before the nominal ToA: 3.8x the anchor systematic and 11-23x the published EQUAD -- exceeds the quoted systematics; unexplained
detection_sbid_62646.polarization: 36% circular, inside the published main-pulse 30-60% band

published_epoch_recoveries.askap_j1832_0911_sbid_60804: in the Wang et al. campaign table: 2024-04-04 22:03:15, ASKAP, 12 min, peak 1522 +/- 4 mJy; our 250 mJy is the 12-min average (arXiv:2411.16606, wang2025)
published_epoch_recoveries.askap_j1755_2527_sbid_47253: labelled 'original discovery' in the McSweeney et al. observation table; timing PEPOCH = MJD 59965.03792 +/- 0.00003 (arXiv:2507.14448, mcsweeney2025, MNRAS 542, 203)

method: arXiv API title/abstract/comment search for 'J1839-0756' and 'J183950.5-075635': only the discovery paper (2501.09133)
Semantic Scholar citations of 2501.09133: 26 citing works enumerated

full-text e-print search of the three plausible reporters -- 2604.11881 (ASKAP VAST short-lived transients sample), 2601.10393 (LPT comprehensive review), 2604.11317 (LPT timing test): no mention of SBIDs 62032/62646 or any new J1839-0756 epoch; the review's J1839-0756 content cites only the discovery paper; the other two mention only GPM J1839-10
novelty_pass_2026_08_15.limitations: arXiv 'all:' search does not cover full text of non-citing papers; ADS full-text search not run (no API key in this environment). Scope is stated in the paper text.
novelty_pass_2026_08_15.verdict: No report of these epochs found as of 2026-08-15.
